metadata.name: Publish - Description (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
Numbers are your thing. You know your way around financial statements. And when
something doesn’t add up, you’re the person who wants to find out why.
We’re looking for a versatile, hands-on accountant who can take ownership, work independently,
and keep things moving even when priorities change. You’ll be responsible for financial
statements and accounting activities across multiple companies, while also helping solve
unexpected challenges that come with the job.
If that sounds like something you're passionate about, apply now!

- Independently prepare corporate income tax calculations and ensure timely preparation and submission of related tax payments and documentation.
- Prepare and submit statistical reports and VAT returns, as well as support other tax and regulatory reporting requirements.
- Maintain and reconcile balance sheet, general ledger, and sub-ledger accounts, including intercompany, supplier, and customer accounts.
- Prepare and maintain documentation and supporting files for monthly and year-end reporting.
- Prepare data and documentation for set-off agreements, dividend resolutions, and other corporate accounting matters.
- Actively participate in local and group audit processes, including preparing financial statements, reports, and supporting documentation.
- Monitor accounting and tax obligations, identify process-related risks and opportunities, and propose practical solutions and improvements.
- Contribute to improving accounting processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency, accuracy, and quality.

Your mission is to maximize revenue by combining analytical expertise, technical understanding, and strong business acumen. If that’s a mission you want to accept, then take this opportunity to make your mark.

metadata.name: Publish - Description (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
The Team
The Growth team is focused on maximising the potential of all titles Outfit7 ships. It brings together user acquisition, creative strategy, ASO, data, and product collaboration under one roof, with full-funnel accountability for the games in its portfolio. We operate across all lifecycle stages, from R&D and prototype validation through to global scale, across a range of mobile game formats.


As our Distribution Analytics Lead, you'll build and develop a high-impact team that turns complex marketing and distribution data into smarter, faster decisions. From supporting a paid user acquisition strategy to incrementality testing, you'll define how Outfit7 measures, learns, and scales across every distribution channel, and you'll grow the people who make it happen.

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Build, lead, and grow a team of analysts and data scientists supporting Marketing, Growth, and Distribution.
- Set the Distribution Analytics roadmap and priorities, focusing the team on work with the highest impact on profit growth and channel performance.
- Partner closely with Product and leadership to translate business goals into analytical initiatives, and influence strategic decisions with data.
- Own and continuously improve measurement frameworks for paid user acquisition, including LTV, ROAS, predictive payback, and bidding inputs.
- Drive the adoption of advanced measurement methods such as incrementality testing, geo experiments, and Marketing Mix Modeling.
- Champion organic growth analytics, including measurement of store performance and the interplay between paid and organic.
- Establish experimentation standards across A/B and quasi-experimental designs, statistical guardrails, and clear decision frameworks.
- Set technical standards for the team, including clean and scalable data pipelines, reproducible analyses, and well documented internal tools.
- Represent Distribution Analytics in cross-functional forums, communicate findings to senior leadership, and challenge outdated practices.
- Stay close to industry trends in mobile gaming, performance marketing, and measurement, and bring relevant best practices into the team.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Skills (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Leadership skills:  you've hired, developed, and retained talent in data analytics.
- Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect analytical work to commercial outcomes and prioritize accordingly.
- Strong SQL skills and advanced proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis, modeling and visualization.
- Deep understanding of mobile app economics, LTV and ROAS modeling, attribution, and channel performance measurement.
- Hands-on in designing and running incrementality tests, geo experiments, and/or MMM.
- Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems, run thorough analyses, and turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
- Excellent stakeholder management, you partner with non-technical leaders in Marketing and Growth 
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, fluent in English (written and spoken).
- Excellent attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset.
- A positive, proactive, lead-by-example attitude.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Experience (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- 7+ years of experience in analytics or data science roles, with at least 2 years leading a team (hiring, coaching, and developing analysts or data scientists)
- Track record supporting Distribution: Paid User Acquisition, Performance Marketing, or Growth teams, ideally in mobile games or a comparable consumer app or digital business.
- Experience with modern data stack tools, such as DBT and cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake), and BI tools.
- Experience with ASO analytics and the interaction between paid and organic growth is a strong plus.

Do you want to be legal counsel for a company that works on the global scale in the fast-paced and exciting gaming industry?

We’re looking for someone to join our team and provide legal support for the company across various fields of operations. A team player would be ideal – someone who can work both collaboratively and independently – as would someone with great communication skills, a detail-oriented working style, and a passion for their work. Read on to find out more about the role! 

你是否希望加入一家全球化企业,在快速发展且充满活力的移动游戏行业担任法务顾问?

我们正在寻找一位专业、积极且富有责任心的法务顾问,为公司在多个业务领域提供法律支持。我们期待你既能够与团队紧密协作,也能够独立推动工作;具备优秀的沟通能力、严谨细致的工作态度,以及对法律工作的热情。如果你希望在国际化环境中发挥专业价值,我们期待你的加入!

-     Provide legal support to departments company-wide, as well as legal advice to support easier decision-making and operational activities on the Chinese market.

- 	Monitor legislation and standards, and manage any activities necessary to ensure internal compliance.

 -  审核、起草并协助谈判各类合同,包括但不限于广告、授权许可、劳动用工等合同。

- 持续跟踪法律法规及行业标准变化,推动公司内部合规体系持续完善。
- 根据公司及关联公司的运营需求,负责本地公司治理(Corporate Governance)及相关公司行政法律事务。
